title: Engineering, Expression, Purification, and Application of Glycosaminoglycan‐Specific Antibodies
author: Duraivelan, Sundaravel, et al.
materials: E. coli BL21‐CodonPlus (DE3)‐RIL competent cells (Agilent, cat. no. 230245)
Dithiothreitol (DTT, Gold Bio, cat. no. DTT100)

This protocol describes the workflow for the expression and purification of endotoxin‐free anti‐HS scFvs using the ExpiCHO expression system, where proteins are secreted into the medium (Fig. 1C). Again, the constructs are first tested by small‐scale expression (Fig. 4A,B), then scaled up to larger volumes as needed (Fig. 4C) (Table 2). For small‐scale expression, we follow the manufacturer's standard titer protocol followed by protein A/G purification. For large‐scale expression, we follow the Thermo Fisher Scientific max titer protocol for a 100‐ml culture volume (see ExpiCHO Expression System User Guide, 2018), followed by His60 purification. The proteins exist as homodimers in solution (Fig. 4A), with the individual monomers (Fig. 4B) linked by disulfide bonds in the hinge region of the Fc section. The samples are run on an SDS‐PAGE gel with (Fig. 4B) and without (Fig. 4A) reducing agent to observe these two species.

steps.title: Depyrogenate glassware and wash surfaces
steps.instruction: Incubate all glassware at 250 °C for 3 h to depyrogenate, then wash every surface that contacts samples—including ÄKTA columns and system components—with 0.5 M NaOH (Sigma cat. 221465) in water.

steps.title: Test bacterial scFv expression (96‑well)
steps.instruction: Perform small‑scale expression of each anti‑HS scFv construct in a 96‑well plate as illustrated in Fig. 3A; note that yields vary between constructs (see Table 2).

steps.title: Scale up bacterial scFv expression
steps.instruction: Scale up successful constructs to larger culture volumes following the workflow shown in Fig. 3B, adjusting the volume as needed for each construct.

steps.title: Small‑scale ExpiCHO expression and Protein A/G purification
steps.instruction: Follow the ExpiCHO manufacturer’s standard titer protocol to express anti‑HS scFvs in a small‑scale format, then purify the secreted proteins using Protein A/G resin according to the resin’s instructions.

steps.title: Large‑scale ExpiCHO expression and His60 purification
steps.instruction: Run a 100‑ml ExpiCHO culture using the Thermo Fisher max‑titer protocol (see ExpiCHO Expression System User Guide, 2018); after secretion, purify the scFvs with His60 affinity beads under endotoxin‑free conditions.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE with/without reducing agent
steps.instruction: Prepare samples and run an SDS‑PAGE gel; include a reduced lane (e.g., with β‑mercaptoethanol) to observe monomers and a non‑reduced lane to observe homodimer species as shown in Fig. 4A/B.

steps.title: Indirect labeling of live Jurkat cells
steps.instruction: Incubate live Jurkat E6‑1 cells with anti‑His scFv forms, then add a fluorophore‑conjugated secondary anti‑His antibody as described in Fig. 7A for flow‑cytometry analysis.

steps.title: Indirect labeling of fixed Vero cells
steps.instruction: Harvest Vero cells (use PBS + 5 mM EDTA and gentle pipetting for weakly adherent cells, or enzymatic dissociation with TrypLE or Trypsin for strongly adherent cells, avoiding prolonged enzyme exposure); fix the cells, then stain with anti‑HS scFv followed by a fluorophore‑conjugated secondary anti‑His antibody, performing fixation between the two labeling steps as in Fig. 7B.

steps.title: Direct labeling of live Vero cells
steps.instruction: Label live Vero cells directly with fluorophore‑conjugated anti‑HS scFvs prepared as described in Basic Protocol 3, then analyze by flow cytometry (Fig. 7C).

steps.title: Prepare immunofluorescence staining buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 1× PBS (pH 7.4, calcium‑ and magnesium‑free; Gibco cat. 70011‑04) with 1 % w/v BSA (fraction V, RPI cat. A30075‑100.0); sterilize the solution using a 1000‑ml vacuum filtration system (GenClone cat. 25‑229) and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare SDS‑PAGE staining solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 80 mg Coomassie brilliant blue G‑250 in 1 L H₂O, stir for 4 h; add 3 ml concentrated HCl, stir an additional 10 min; store the solution at room temperature. The solution remains usable for months (the authors have used it for ~4 months).
